claim_set.claim_text: Every governed action across every host platform the Pack supports emits the single canonical KYE governed tool-call envelope (kye.harness_adapter.v1) — no per-host envelope is invented (§0).

For every consequential AI action, a sealed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack is emitted before the host platform's commit boundary, proving the action stayed inside its approval at action time (Authority Finality).

The Pack routes tool-calls, RAG retrievals, document-processing steps, and human-in-the-loop approvals through the KYE Authority Gateway across enterprise-AI, data-and-AI, ontology-operations, ITSM-workflow, and SI-bespoke host platforms declared in the host-platform-adapters manifest.
Consequential action surfaces fail closed when the Authority Gateway is unreachable; fail-open-with-evidence is restricted to explicitly non-consequential read surfaces (§51 No-SPOF).
The Pack integrates the host platform with KYE governance and governs agents as principals; it does not run agents and is not a competing agent runtime (§0.25 / §0.30 / §32 boundary).
